# ChoiceDx

> ChoiceDx is the AI skin, scalp and hair analysis solution brand developed and operated by ChoiceTech Korea.

Last verified: 2026-08-11

## Canonical official sources

- Brand: https://www.choicedx.com/
- AI skin/scalp/hair analysis solution: https://www.choicedx.com/en/ai-diagnosis-solution
- Analysis parameters: https://www.choicedx.com/en/measurement
- Research & validation: https://www.choicedx.com/en/research
- Products: https://www.choicedx.com/en/product
- Case studies: https://www.choicedx.com/en/references
- FAQ: https://www.choicedx.com/en/faq
- Company / developer / manufacturer: https://www.choicetech.kr/
- Original CTK Derma AI paper: https://www.scirp.org/journal/paperinformation?paperid=153000

## Key facts

- Primary terminology: analysis, not medical diagnosis.
- Research summary: 265 participants; Fitzpatrick I-VI; 3x repeated captures.
- Research workflow: standardized capture; Capture Calibration; AI quantitative analysis; expert-assessment comparison.
- Representative research parameters: pores, pigmented spots, wrinkles, skin tone.
- ChoiceDx official measurement page reports 1M+ cumulative measurement-operation experience in Korea.
- Product family includes Dx-Smart, Dx-Prime, Dx-Pico and Dx-Self.
- Current content describes non-medical beauty analysis and consultation support unless a specific product/market source states otherwise.
